items.title: TikTok faces class action after teens take their own lives
items.description: France is set to follow Australia with a social media ban but for these families, who are suing TikTok over what they say is a harmful algorithm, the battle is only beginning.

items.title: 'Brown packages filled with money' being offered in alleged DVA fraud
items.description: A representative for a telehealth company has been caught offering a military advocate a "kickback" for every veteran who signs up to an ongoing medicinal cannabis prescription.

items.title: Obstetrician sentenced to more than 10 years in jail for woman's death in car smash
items.description: A Perth obstetrician who killed a 24-year-old woman after smashing his high performance luxury car into the small hatchback she was a passenger in is sentenced to 10 years and six months in jail.

items.title: 'Our lives have been shattered': Gus's parents release statement
items.description: The parents of missing four-year-old Gus Lamont have released a public statement, saying "every moment without him is unbearable".

items.title: Banning trans women from lesbian group could 'undermine dignity', court hears
items.description: Transgender women will have their dignity "undermined" and could be made to feel "inferior" if a lesbian group is allowed to ban them from events, a court has heard.

items.title: AI body scrapped after spending $188k finding experts
items.description: It took 15 months to narrow a field of 270 AI experts to 12 appointees for an AI authority, at a cost of almost $200,000, before it was suddenly scrapped by the federal government.

items.title: Aussies among first to arrive in UK under controversial new passport rules
items.description: Australians flying to the United Kingdom tonight will be among the first in the world to arrive under controversial new border rules.

items.title: Police suspect human remains to be abducted Sydney man
items.description: Eighty-five-year-old Chris Baghsarian was mistakenly snatched from his North Ryde property about 5am on February 13.

items.title: Wet and stormy forecast as slow moving low pressure system sets in
items.description: There are widespread warnings for intense rain and potential flooding, as summer storms hit southern states and an unusually slow-moving system soaks central Australia.

items.title: Most flu deaths this century were recorded in 2025, ABS finds
items.description: There were more deaths associated with influenza last year than any other year this century, according to the Australia Bureau of Statistics.

items.title: Former RBA governor calls for capital gains tax discount to be scrapped
items.description: Bernie Fraser tells a Senate committee hearing on capital gains tax that, if it were up to him, he would abolish the discount, as he warns younger Australians are watching the unaffordable housing market in "dismay".

items.title: Victorian premier refers allegations against gynaecologist to police
items.description: Victorian Premier Jacinta Allan has referred allegations against gynaecologist Simon Gordon to police, but the government will not conduct its own investigation.

items.title: Europe's 'royal highness' approach to Trump has been exposed, analyst says
items.description: A former chief analyst with the Danish Defence Intelligence Service warns diplomatic efforts to settle the Greenland dispute will fail.

items.title: Developer behind planned Gold Coast Trump Tower had two bankruptcies
items.description: A search by the ABC of federal insolvency records reveals the developer has had personal financial scrapes.

items.title: Trump seems to mock US women's hockey team while congratulating men on gold
items.description: Viral video of Trump's White House invitation to the US men's hockey team sparks backlash online after the president jokes he would be 'impeached' if he did not also include the gold-medal winning women's team.

items.title: Barty to dust cobwebs off golf clubs at NZ Open
items.description: Ash Barty, Kelly Slater and Ricky Ponting are among the multi-talented sports stars in action in the pro-am component of the NZ Open.

items.title: Australia's long wait for a high-speed train
items.description: It has been more than 40 years since the idea of high-speed rail (HSR) was first floated in Australia, but is it finally about to become a reality?

items.title: Belly rubs and finding bombs: Explosive detection dog honoured
items.description: In July 2007, explosive detection dog Flo Joe became the first Australian service dog to locate an improvised explosive device in Afghanistan. Today, she was posthumously recognised for her military service.

items.title: WIN Network buys Nine Darwin, expanding operations to the NT
items.description: Regional news broadcaster WIN has announced it will acquire Nine Darwin, just over a year after the Nine Network suddenly axed its Darwin TV news bulletin.

items.title: Man who ferried multi-million-dollar cocaine haul 'doing mate a favour'
items.description: One of three men who used a dinghy to haul 110 kilograms of cocaine onto the Australian mainland has been jailed after telling a court he was helping a friend in exchange for a free boat trip.

items.title: Family grieves 'loving, caring and beautiful' mum who died alone in prison cell
items.description: Tammy Shipley died in a NSW prison cell in December 2022 after consuming excessive water, a complication of schizoaffective disorder known as polydipsia. Today her children told a coronial inquest that "if love could have saved her, she could have lived forever".

items.title: Queensland man charged with 11 counts of rape, dozens of other offences
items.description: Sunshine Coast man Riccardo Valenza, 31, has been remanded in custody after police charged him with 31 offences relating to 11 alleged victims.

items.title: Could former prince Andrew be removed from the line of succession?
items.description: Is it possible to remove him? The short answer is yes — but it would most likely be a time-consuming process involving many parliaments passing legislation.

items.title: Notre Dame uni suddenly halts nursing course enrolments
items.description: Staff and prospective students say they have been left in the dark about why the university cancelled new nursing and midwifery students in the first semester of 2026.

items.title: Inaugural trans-Tasman yacht race postponed
items.description: The first running of the Trans-Tasman Yacht Race between Sydney and Auckland is called off days out from the start, after the withdrawal of the majority of entries.
